entities.summary: Robert Anthony John Hewitt is a former professional tennis player from Australia. In 1967, after marrying a South African, he became a South African citizen. He has won 15 major titles and a career Grand Slam in both men's and mixed doubles. Bob Hewitt was a athletes & competitors from Dubbo (b. 1940-01-12, Dubbo).
